keys.swarm.aura_rending_gale_desc: You fling a crescent of wind forward; it widens as it flies, slicing through and throwing monsters aside to split the horde.
keys.swarm.aura_rending_gale_up: Wider crescents; two at once from level 6.
keys.swarm.aura_rending_gale_ten: Hurricane: a tornado wanders the field, pulling monsters round it.
keys.swarm.aura_bloodlust_desc: Monsters you kill spill blood that flies back into you, healing you and speeding you up.
keys.swarm.aura_bloodlust_ten: Crimson Tide: a wave of blood rolls outward from you.
